overall_goal: Wash the rice, add water and salt, and place it on the cooker to boil.

goals.description: Set up the scales, pan, and sieve.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves the scales, pan, and sieve and arranges them on the counter to prepare for measuring the rice.
The person gets the bag of rice, adjusts the scale units, and pours the desired amount of rice into the sieve.
The person clears space in the sink and rinses the rice in the sieve under cold running water to remove the starch.

goals.description: Transfer the rice to the pan and add water.
goals.rationale: The person empties the washed rice into the pan, then fills a glass with water and pours it into the pan on the scales.

goals.description: Place the pan on the cooker and add salt.
goals.rationale: The person moves the pan to the cooker, adds a pinch of salt, and positions the pan on the stove to begin cooking.
